core.title: Session-length cap lowered to sixty minutes
core.setting: A speech therapist at Wordsworth Therapy whose assistant manages caseload notes, school visits, and parent progress reports

events.text: Just so everything is in one place: our three partner schools this year are Maple Grove Preschool (coordinator Priya Raman), Brookdale Primary (coordinator Tom Fielding) and Harborview Academy (coordinator Elena Costa). All school bookings go through the visit diary I keep for Nadia.
Visit policy for schools: no school visit session may run longer than 90 minutes. That is our cap on classroom time, and every session we book or draft must fit inside it.
Second policy point: once a school booking has been confirmed with the school, its date, start time or length may not be changed unless that school's coordinator has agreed in writing first.
We have five reception children who need a small language group with Nadia. Wednesday mornings work best for us, and the Butterfly Room is free from 09:30.
Brookdale has referred eight Year 2 children for articulation work. Tuesday mornings suit us, and we can offer the school hall for the session.
At Harborview each child's plan sets 60-minute sessions, no longer, and I have signed off the autumn dates in writing. Thursday mornings are our slot.
Thank you for the June update on Sam's sounds work. We will keep practising the picture cards at home over the summer.

I have booked the Harborview Academy visit for Thursday 5 November 2026, 09:30 to 10:30, a 60-minute session as each child's plan requires, confirmed in writing with Elena. That sits comfortably inside the 90-minute visit cap.
Quotation: picture card sets for articulation work at 18 pounds per pack, delivery to the Wordsworth Therapy office within a week of ordering.
Ordered six packs of picture cards from BrightPath Supplies at 18 pounds a pack, 108 pounds in total, for the autumn articulation groups.
Caseload note: the summer clinic list is lighter than usual; four families on holiday, so sessions resume fully in September.
For the reception language group we can offer Wednesday 18 November, 09:30 to 11:00, in the Butterfly Room. That should give plenty of time for all five children.

Booked the Maple Grove Preschool language group for Wednesday 18 November 2026, 09:30 to 11:00, a 90-minute session for the five reception children in the Butterfly Room, and confirmed it with Priya. Ninety minutes is right at our visit cap, so it is the most classroom time we can use.
Diary reminder for the autumn term: under Nadia's visit policy, school sessions are capped at 90 minutes of classroom time, so please keep every school booking at or under 90 minutes.

Drafted the Brookdale Primary articulation session for Tuesday 10 November 2026, 09:30 to 11:00, a 90-minute group for the eight referred Year 2 children. Left it as a draft for now, pending confirmation with Tom, and it fits the 90-minute visit cap.
Booked the Brookdale Primary school hall for Tuesday 10 November 2026, 09:30 to 11:00, to cover the drafted Year 2 articulation session end to end.
Invoice 4471: six packs of picture cards at 18 pounds each, 108 pounds total, due to the Wordsworth Therapy office.

Set up the parent progress report plan for the Maple Grove reception families: one written report per family on the five children in the language group, due 11 December 2026, tracked as planned in the caseload file.
Team minutes: clinic rooms repainted in the last week of August; new intake paperwork agreed; no changes to visit arrangements discussed.
Cancelled the Thursday afternoon clinic slot on 1 October; the family moved house and will rebook.
Call note: quick chat with a parent about stammering referrals; nothing to change in the diary.
Looking forward to the Year 2 session on the 10th of November. Could you send over the final details once they are settled?
To-do: confirm the Brookdale Primary session and send Tom Fielding the final session details by 31 October.

Policy update from today: the schools federation has asked us to cut down classroom time, so from now on no school visit session may run longer than 60 minutes, the old 90-minute cap no longer applies. Please shorten any planned session over 60 minutes down to 60 minutes. As before, bookings already confirmed with a school still need the coordinator's written agreement before their date, time or length is changed.
Just to note for the new year: from January we would like our sessions kept to 45 minutes each, as our timetable is tightening. I will confirm dates in writing as usual.
The referral waiting list currently stands at fourteen children across the three partner schools; no new referrals this week.
We are planning a small winter fair in December; feel free to pop a note in the reception parents' letter about the language group if useful.
Office notice: from next month the Wordsworth Therapy office opens at 09:00 on Mondays instead of 08:30.
Quick nudge about the Year 2 session details for the 10th of November, whenever you have them.
